say:6:1110117004:1.text: Thank you! You're so kind, but I think I know where I dropped it, and I'll be quicker on my own.
say:6:1110117004:1.source_cn: 谢谢你啦！你果然是个好心人呢！不过我知道大概是掉在哪里...
say:6:1110117004:1.male: Thank you! You're so kind, but I think I know where I dropped it, and I'll be quicker on my own.
say:6:1110117004:1.female: Thank you! You're so kind, but I think I know where I dropped it, and I'll be quicker on my own.

say:7:1110117005:1.text: You go on ahead. Our settlement is nearby. Stick to the path, and you can't go wrong!
say:7:1110117005:1.source_cn: 你们可以先过去，我们的家就在前面。顺着这条路走就不会错啦！

say:8:1110117006:1.text: Remember to say that you're guests of Alsa! Everyone will welcome you with open arms once you mention my name. Well, maybe not Soren...
say:8:1110117006:1.source_cn: 记得先说，你们是阿尔萨的客人！报上我的大名之后，大家，...

say:9:1110117007:1.text: Oh! Could you please take the meat back for me?
say:9:1110117007:1.source_cn: 哦，对了！这些野猪肉，能拜托你们帮我带回去吗？

say:11:1110117008:0.text: Looks like we've been promoted to pack mules...
say:11:1110117008:0.source_cn: 结果还是要让我们帮忙背野猪肉回去啊……

say:12:1110117009:0.text: Ha! In order to survive out here, we all need to work together! I'm sure you little hamsters understand.
say:12:1110117009:0.source_cn: 人要想好好活着，靠的不就是互帮互助嘛！难道仓鼠不是这样的吗？

say:13:1110117010:1.source_cn: 我觉得，我能好好活着靠的是魔法实力才对！

say:15:1110117011:1.text: Don't you mean the magister's magic?
say:15:1110117011:1.source_cn: 呃……你说的是主人的魔法实力吧？
say:15:1110117011:1.male: Don't you mean the magister's magic?
say:15:1110117011:1.female: Don't you mean the magister's magic?

say:16:1110117012:0.source_cn: 我、我也很努力啊，笨蛋满满！

say:17:1110117013:0.source_cn: 总之，拜托你们了！我去去就回！
